title: Chapter 659 - 659 Beast Tide; Strength Rankings!
content:
Chapter 659 - 659 Beast Tide; Strength Rankings!

Chapter 659 - 659 Beast Tide; Strength Rankings!

659 Beast Tide; Strength Rankings!

While many students were praising him, a strange voice sounded.

“Is this Four-Eyed Hell Hound really that powerful?”

As Li Dongqiang spoke, he sized up the Four-Eyed Hell Hound from top to bottom, from left to right.

Qiao Kai raised his head and said, “It’s not too powerful. It’s only at the level of a D-class special ability user.”

Although it was not too impressive, the smugness in his tone was obvious.

“Really?” Li Dongqiang touched his chin and said.

At this moment, a series of brisk footsteps sounded from outside the corridor.

Xia Xue, who was standing by the door, casually glanced at the door.

Her beautiful eyes lit up.

That was because a tall and handsome figure appeared in front of him.

It was Lin Fan!

Beside Lin Fan’s feet was a small white dog.

Xia Xue’s beautiful eyes brightened a little, and she said with a smile, “What a cute puppy.”

As she spoke, she lowered her head and wanted to stroke the Heavenly Hound’s head.

One had to know…

A thousand years ago, the Heavenly Hound was already a level-eight exotic beast.

Over the past thousand years, Lin Fan had been absorbing the energy of the orb of light. The Heavenly Hound had been by his side, and it had also benefited greatly.

The current Heavenly Hound could even become a king and emperor without any problems.

How could it be touched by ordinary people?

It was about to refuse.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s voice rang out in the Heavenly Hound’s mind.

“Let her touch you.”

The aura around the Heavenly Hound suddenly withdrew, allowing Xia Xue to stroke it.

“Lin Fan, is this your dog?” Li Dongqiang asked curiously. “Is it a mutated beast or an ordinary dog?”

Lin Fan said, “I don’t know.”

“What a coincidence,” Li Dongqiang said to himself. “You and Qiao Kai both brought dogs today.”

The Heavenly Hound looked in the direction that Li Dongqiang was pointing at, and its face was full of disdain.

It was this glance that scared the Four-Eyed Hell Hound so much that its limbs went limp and it fell to the ground.

This was normal…

The Four-Eyed Hell Hound was only a D-class exotic beast, much weaker than the Heavenly Hound when it was young.

Furthermore, the Heavenly Hound could call itself a king or an emperor.

An emperor’s gaze was as heavy as a mountain!

Li Dongqiang also noticed this and smiled. “Qiao Kai, why is your Four-Eyed Hell Hound crawling on the ground? Could it be that it has diarrhea, so it has lost its strength? Is it really a Four-Eyed Hell Hound?”

Qiao Kai also felt a little embarrassed and shouted, “Big Black, Big Black, quickly get up!”

However, no matter how he shouted and dragged it, the Four-Eyed Hell Hound did not get up.

After the bell rang, the math teacher strode in.

He first gave Lin Fan a warm smile and then started today’s lesson.

The day’s lessons passed in the blink of an eye. The sun gradually set, dyeing the entire sky red.

At this moment, hurried footsteps sounded from outside the corridor.

Then, Qin Chuan, walked in quickly.

He glanced at the students in the class and said, “According to the news, a large number of exotic beasts have been gathering in Jiangbei since last night!

“This is an extremely rare and terrifying beast tide! Of course, we don’t have to worry too much because the Xia Alliance has already sent out special ability teams to defend. They’ll definitely be able to stop the beast tide outside the city.

“However, there’s still a possibility that a small number of exotic beasts have slipped through the net and entered Jiangbei. It’s very dangerous! Therefore, Jiangbei has activated the emergency plan.

“From now on, unless absolutely necessary, try not to leave the school.”

Hearing this, everyone in the class could not help but feel their hearts beating faster.

Some people were excited, but more people were afraid.

Qin Chuan seemed to have something to deal with, so he left the classroom after he finished speaking.

Only the students in the classroom were left looking at each other.

Then, they carefully walked out.

Jiangbei University, third floor of Block 8, the male dormitory.

A thousand years ago, most of the student dormitories had four people in a room.

The current student dormitory had become a luxurious smart suite with two bedrooms and one living room.

As soon as Lin Fan entered the dormitory, a sweet-looking android came over and said in an extremely clear voice, “Welcome home. Would you like something to drink?”

“No need,” Lin Fan said.

Zhang Wenzhuo, who had returned to the dormitory first, said, “Lin Fan, you’re finally back in the dormitory.

“You don’t know how lonely I’ve been in the dormitory these past few days!”

As he spoke, he was about to give Lin Fan a big bear hug.

However, Lin Fan’s body turned slightly to the side.

Zhang Wenzhuo could not help but feel a little embarrassed.

He quickly turned his attention to the Heavenly Hound and said, “When I was in class, I wanted to touch it. Now, I finally have the chance, hehe!”

Zhang Wenzhuo bent down and reached out to stroke the Heavenly Hound’s head.

The reason why Xia Xue could touch the Heavenly Hound was because of Lin Fan’s instructions.

Zhang Wenzhuo did not have such good treatment.

The Heavenly Hound twisted its body and easily dodged to the side.

“Little dog, I have a lot of delicious food here. Come over to me…” Zhang Wenzhuo said.

However, the Heavenly Hound just stood in the distance and watched him perform as if he was a monkey. It did not move at all.

Zhang Wenzhuo could not help but feel helpless.

So, he straightened his back and said, “Lin Fan, Jiangbei was just fine before. Why is there a beast tide all of a sudden?”

“Didn’t this happen in Jiangbei before?” asked Lin Fan.

Zhang Wenzhuo thought for a moment and said, “I don’t think so. At least, I don’t have any impression of it, and I haven’t seen any similar news.”

Lin Fan nodded his head and looked out of the dark window into the distance.

…

At this moment, many men and women wearing black cloaks who were emitting extraordinary auras gathered together.

The middle-aged man in the red cloak, Qin Zhong, said, “Dahai, where’s the tide of mutated beasts? How many are there?”

Li Dahai, who was also wearing a red cloak, stood next to him. A dazzling golden light shot out from his forehead.

Instantly, the exotic beasts in the mountains, fields, and rivers all appeared in his field of vision.

After a while, the golden glow between Li Dahai’s eyebrows slowly dissipated. He said in a deep voice, “The beast tide is only about 30 kilometers away from here. It’s probably close to 100,000! Moreover, it’s still increasing!”

As soon as he said that, the atmosphere immediately became gloomy.

Everyone knew what this data meant.

“No matter what, we must defend!” Qin Zhong took a deep breath and said. “In addition, I’ve already transferred 100 super laser weapons and a large number of reinforcements. They’re already on their way!”

At this moment, a dazzling golden light suddenly appeared in the originally dark night.

These golden lights continuously condensed and twisted…

Gradually, they turned into three large golden words—’Strength Rankings’!
